children: NODWIN Gaming launches NODWIN Sports with Gurbaksh Virdi at the helm, targeting sports IPs, events and commercial partnerships in the Global South

IPO-bound NODWIN Gaming has unviels NODWIN Sports, a mainstream sports vertical focused on developing sporting properties, mass-participation events and commercial partnerships, according to a media report.

The move expands NODWIN Gaming’s presence beyond gaming and esports as the company looks to build a broader youth media and entertainment business spanning live events, content and intellectual property.

NODWIN Sports will develop original sports and fitness properties, advise sports federations and governing bodies, facilitate brand and media partnerships, and provide operational and production support for sporting events.
India will serve as the base for NODWIN Sports’ expansion across markets in the Global South, the company said in a statement.

The launch comes as NODWIN Gaming prepares for a potential initial public offering. In March, co-founder and Managing Director Akshat Rathee told the media that the company was looking to raise around USD 100 million in a pre-IPO funding round, according to a media report.
Gurbaksh Singh Virdi has joined NODWIN Gaming as Vice President to lead the new sports vertical.
Virdi has previously worked with Red Bull, U Sports, PUMA, Cornerstone and Adidas India across sports marketing, athlete management, intellectual property development and commercial partnerships.

He also worked on running initiatives for Virat Kohli’s One8 brand at Cornerstone. Most recently, as Sports Marketing Lead at Adidas India, he managed the brand’s initiatives across cricket, running, training, football and motorsport, including partnerships with the Board of Control for Cricket in India and the Indian Olympic Association.
NODWIN Sports will leverage the company’s capabilities across content, production, partnerships and community engagement to develop and operate sporting properties.

The company said its experience in building youth-focused properties such as the BGMI Masters Series, Comic Con India, NH7 Weekender and VCSA would help it create sports intellectual properties targeting younger audiences.

Founded in 2014 by Rathee and Gautam Virk, NODWIN Gaming operates across gaming, esports, pop culture, music, live events and content. Its investors include Nazara Technologies, KRAFTON, Sony Group Corporation, JetSynthesys and Good Game Investments.
The company operates in more than 20 countries and has expanded through acquisitions and investments across gaming, esports and youth entertainment.

NODWIN Gaming is also taking a measured approach to its IPO timeline. Rathee had previously said that the company would file its draft papers after achieving financial, governance, investor and internal readiness.
